purpose: Require mechanistic Ca/Land source-stress fields in Phase 2B reports so peak Ca amplitude, absolute Ca, strain, lambda and stress timing are not misread before Level 3 transfer.

requiredFields.name: fixedFiberEngineeringStrain
requiredFields.description: Fixed engineering strain used by the isometric Phase 2B twitch.

requiredFields.name: lambda
requiredFields.description: Fiber stretch ratio corresponding to fixedFiberEngineeringStrain.

requiredFields.name: hLambda
requiredFields.description: Land length-dependent factor h(lambda), reported for mechanistic traceability.

requiredFields.name: diastolicCaUM
requiredFields.description: Diastolic free Ca baseline used by the prescribed transient.

requiredFields.name: targetPeakAmplitudeUM
requiredFields.description: Peak amplitude above diastolic Ca, not the absolute target peak.

requiredFields.name: targetAbsolutePeakCaUM
requiredFields.description: Absolute target peak Ca = diastolicCaUM + targetPeakAmplitudeUM.

requiredFields.name: measuredPeakCaUM
requiredFields.description: Measured absolute peak free Ca in the Phase 2B trace.

requiredFields.name: caPeakTimeMs
requiredFields.description: Time of measured peak free Ca.

requiredFields.name: CaT50AtFixedStrainUM
requiredFields.description: CaT50 evaluated at the fixed Phase 2B strain, using the accepted Land source parameterization.

requiredFields.name: CaAtStressPeakUM
requiredFields.description: Free Ca value at sourceActiveFiberStressPa peak.

clarifications: targetPeakAmplitudeUM is an amplitude above diastolic Ca, not an absolute Ca target.

For the current Phase 2B review example, peakAmplitudeUM=0.9 with diastolicCaUM=0.12 implies targetAbsolutePeakCaUM≈1.02 uM; a measuredPeakCaUM≈1.016 uM is close to the absolute target and must not be interpreted as a 13% overshoot.
Reports should include both targetPeakAmplitudeUM and targetAbsolutePeakCaUM whenever prescribed Ca peak behavior is discussed.
